page.layout: One page of text; running head at top; right and left edges cut by the scan. Verse and headings in the central block; no marginal notes visible.

main_text.head: CL. V. IOACH. CAMERARIO, viro doctorum ætatis iuæ Germanorum facilè principi.

p.i: Ergo meos etiam laudas, Ioachime, libellos, Et mea, quæ recitas, carmina digna putas: O nimium natos felici sydere versus, Quos tam facundo contigit ore canî! I nunc, Mome, crepa. Nam quis, nisi pessimus, illa Nunc odisse velit, quæ Ioachimus amet?

main_text.head: In Rom. Pontificum carnificinam.

p.i: Et flammis & aquis crustacea numina fausta Roma tuetur Pontifex. Nec mirum. Hæc etenim crustacea numina cer- Formant aqua, flamma coquunt.

main_text.head: In nouam Ecclesiæ Apostaticæ Triadem.

p.i: Dira Trias, pictor, pistor, pastorque furente: Plerusque arbitrio fert agitatque suo. Ille Deos pingens, hic pinsens, cautor illis Pastor, cui cibus est ille vtriusque labor: Artibus haud parvis: aliis spectacula præbens, Dans aliis præter parvula crusta nihil. Quàm cautus, cui pro nihilo sic omnia cedunt! Quàm stulti huic dantes omnia pro nihilo!

page.notes: Left and right edges of the scan are clipped, so line ends are cut off (e.g. "fau-", "cer-", "numina ... pro nihilo"). Line-final words are reconstructed where the cut is partial; doubtful letters are unmarked because the lines are legible. The verse "Ergo meos" line ends are partly lost at the right edge. Handwritten annotations and marks in the margins are not transcribed.
